Chapter 1228: Chapter 35: The Invincible Lin Yuan (Please Subscribe)_2

It was never considered at all.

After all, trading with the Thunderclap Ancient Country carries too much risk. Even if the two Ancient Countries handed over all refined core pillars to the Thunderclap Ancient Country, it’s uncertain whether the latter can seize this treasure land.

If in the end it is still taken by the Da Fu or Fierce Sun faction, then wouldn’t the investment of the Da Ling Ancient Country and Xuanyin Ancient Country be in vain?

"Alright, no need to speak of this anymore."

Just then, Man Kun Venerable spoke, sweeping his gaze over the Peak Venerables present, "At this point, our Barbarian Wilderness Country can only stand with the Fierce Sun Ancient Country. Even if we can’t seize the treasure land ourselves, we must do everything we can to help Fierce Sun Ancient Country seize it."

With Da Fu Ancient Country taking along Xuanyin Ancient Country, Da Ling Ancient Country, and Thunderclap Ancient Country, forming an overwhelming advantage, if Barbarian Wilderness Country were to turn to Da Fu Ancient Country now, it would be merely icing on the cake.

The Da Fu Ancient Country wouldn’t have to pay much for it either.

Therefore.

Barbarian Wilderness Country has only one choice.

That is to stand with the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Currently, although Da Fu Ancient Country holds an absolute advantage.

But the real decisive battle has yet to come; Fierce Sun Ancient Country and Barbarian Wilderness Country might still have a chance.

The remaining eleven Peak Venerables, upon hearing these words, showed a solemn demeanor and nodded slightly.

Indeed.

Barbarian Wilderness Country now has only the path of aligning with Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

...

Before the third colossal core pillar.

Embodiments of the Peak Venerables from Da Fu Ancient Country, Xuanyin Ancient Country, Da Ling Ancient Country, and Thunderclap Ancient Country gathered.

"Hahaha, everyone, although we now occupy the refined core pillars, far exceeding the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, we cannot become complacent," Fu Xu Venerate smiled slightly, looking at the Peak Venerables below.

Normally, such contests for newly emerged treasure lands erupt into decisive battles in the last century.

The so-called decisive battle involves the strongest powers from various ancient countries striking with full force, without any reservations.

Of course, even in the final decisive battle, Fu Xu Venerate is fully confident that a head start leads to continued advantage.

What’s more, how much more than a head start does Da Fu Ancient Country currently hold? Fu Xu Venerate only needs to keep the Galaxy Venerate occupied, and nothing significant can occur in Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

"Then let me prematurely congratulate Fu Xu, brother..." Su Yin Heavenly Venerate of Xuanyin Ancient Country was about to speak.

Suddenly.

Among the Peak Venerables of Thunderclap Ancient Country below, Leisa Venerable’s expression slightly changed.

"Fu Xu."

Leisa Venerable immediately spoke: "That Galaxy Venerate suddenly appeared near one of the core pillars I was refining..."

"Oh?"

Upon hearing this, Fu Xu Venerate’s expression became slightly grave, "First, ask Galaxy Venerate what he intends to do?"

This behavior by Galaxy Venerate led Fu Xu Venerate to easily associate it with the decisive battle.

However, Fu Xu Venerate still harbored doubts; normal contests for treasure lands in decisive battles revolve around colossal core pillars, even if there are no colossal core pillars, they focus on core pillars at the central position.

Only thus can one advance or retreat freely.

But according to Leisa Venerable, the position where Galaxy Venerate appeared was on the edge of the treasure land?

"Alright..."

Leisa Venerable nodded but then immediately showed a dazed expression.

"What’s wrong?"

Fu Xu Venerate noticed and immediately inquired.

He vaguely sensed something amiss from Leisa Venerable’s demeanor.

"Fu Xu Venerate, the main battle body I stationed at that core pillar has fallen."

Leisa Venerable gathered his thoughts promptly and spoke up.

"Fallen?"

Fu Xu Venerate was also a bit stunned, so quickly?

Bear in mind, Leisa Venerable is a top-tier Peak Venerable of the Thunderclap Ancient Country, a lifeform born from boundless thunder.

Such a strong being, with great survival skills, even Fu Xu Venerate, to completely annihilate, would have to do so gradually.

"What about the Thunderclap Ancient Country’s backing weapon?"

Fu Xu Venerate immediately inquired.

"Didn’t have time to use it."

Leisa Venerable swallowed hard, unable to help but continue: "That Galaxy Venerate..."

Leisa Venerable’s tone hinted at fear.

"Didn’t have time to use it?"

Fu Xu Venerate fell into silence.

With the mental will of a top-tier Peak Venerable, an ancient country’s backing weapon can be activated with a single thought.

As for not having time to use it? It meant there was no reaction from start to finish.

How is this possible?

Top-tier Peak Venerable, without even having a chance to react, just perished?

Fu Xu Venerate’s mind was shaken, hard to calm.

Even the Strongest Venerable also holds the Ancient Country’s foundational weapon, and top Peak Venerables have enough reaction time.

As for not even having a chance to react like now...

Fu Xu Venerate’s heart was in shock, and the other Peak Venerables present were equally unsettled.

Leisa Venerable’s encounter was too bizarre, how could a dignified top Peak Venerable not even have the ability to react?

This is too absurd, could it be that the Galaxy Venerate has reached the Primordial Ancestor level?

"Fu Xu Venerate."

At this moment, the Linggan Venerable Sage of the Da Ling Ancient Country suddenly spoke: "That Galaxy Venerate appeared next to the core pillar I guard."

"You must be careful..."

Fu Xu Venerate was startled, immediately reminding.

Although the distance between the two core pillars was rapidly crossed by Galaxy Venerate, Fu Xu Venerate had no time to think about it.

"I..."

Linggan Venerable Sage nodded, but the next moment his face turned pale.

"What happened?"

Fu Xu Venerate realized something was wrong, immediately asked.

"Fallen, the main combat body has fallen."

Linggan Venerable Sage’s voice trembled slightly, with Leisa Venerable’s prior misfortune, he thought he was being very cautious.

The foundational weapon from the Ancient Country was ready to activate at any moment, just waiting to see if the Galaxy Venerate wanted something to say.

Yet he still died quietly, almost instantly as the Galaxy Venerate glanced at him, without a trace of resistance.

"Leisa, Galaxy Venerate he..."

Linggan Venerable Sage immediately looked at Leisa Venerable.

"Don’t look at me, I also died very suddenly."

Leisa Venerable shook his head, still somewhat bewildered and not yet able to comprehend.

"Fu Xu Venerate, Galaxy Venerate, Galaxy Venerate reached my place..."

The Earth Yin Venerable of Xuanyin Ancient Country immediately said.

"Don’t hesitate, directly activate the foundational weapon bestowed by your Xuanyin Ancient Country."

Fu Xu Venerate immediately said, Leisa Venerable and Linggan Venerable Sage’s deaths made him tremble in fear.

Buzz!

A slight ripple transmitted, but was immediately suppressed, like a small flame just ignited, quickly extinguished.

"You?"

Fu Xu Venerate stared at the Earth Yin Venerable.

"Dead."

Earth Yin Venerable shook his head, simultaneously said, "I have already activated the foundational weapon, but the Galaxy Venerate is too strong, the weapon couldn’t withstand it, directly shattered."

"Foundational weapon couldn’t withstand?"

Fu Xu Venerate again fell silent.

The foundational weapons of the various Ancient Countries, although far inferior to Primordial Ancestor level weapons, were crafted casually by the Ancestors themselves, even the Strongest Venerable would need to exhaust effort to break through a foundational weapon’s barrier.

"Fu Xu Venerate, I..."

"Fu Xu Venerate, the Galaxy Venerate reached..."

"Fu Xu Venerate..."

...

As Fu Xu Venerate’s mind was chaotic, below, various top Peak Venerables of different Ancient Countries spoke with frightened tones, all falling to the Galaxy Venerate.

Not even having a moment to react.

Even with the previous top Peak Venerables’ warnings, there was no change whatsoever.

In just three or four breaths.

One hundred and three core pillars were seized and refined by the Galaxy Venerate.

One hundred and three core pillars, spread across nearly half a treasure land, yet lost in just three or four breaths.

"These one hundred and three core pillars..."

Fu Xu Venerate’s heart was shaken, faintly realizing something, a detailed ’map’ of the treasure land immediately appeared before him.

Over three hundred light spots distributed across the map, with a certain corner as the source, large areas of light spots turned red, signifying they were seized and refined by Galaxy Venerate.

"The Galaxy Venerate is sweeping across, starting from the corner and pushing through all the pillars in the treasure land."

Fu Xu Venerate suddenly reacted, whispering in disbelief.

At that moment.

Fu Xu Venerate’s mind shook, feeling as if catastrophe was imminent, he looked towards the heights.

Unbeknownst to him, a young man stood there with hands behind his back, overlooking Fu Xu Venerate and the group of Peak Venerables, eyes squinted, smiling:

"Your turn."
